findings.text: the measure bullet says no git status, ls-files, ls-tree or working-tree diff runs without a pathspec in a full promotion, but the gate at tests/test_promotion_checks_read_only_what_moved.py:296 counts exactly one whole-tree git status --porcelain=v1 (the residue save, which the manifest records under outside_scope), so the fragment overstates the measured result by one whole-tree read.

the commits line lists five of the run's six commits and omits 00e1b1380a, the run's first commit (perf(crew): read a promotion's figure twins from the run's own commits), so the record understates the landed work.

_png_twin_findings_in_run_commits reads only the commits the durable manifest declares, so a commit the run made but omitted from that field is never scanned for a PNG twin; this run's own manifest shows a run can under-declare, and the promotion path closes the gap only because _require_commits_beyond_base separately refuses a manifest without commits.
